tagline: Find it, finance it, insure it, all in one place.
illustrativeDisclaimer: Illustrative figures. Final terms depend on approval and Shari'a-approved contracts.
applyInstantly: Apply, get a virtual card instantly
errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
dealerChooseSubtitle: ⚠️ Sandbox sign-in: no password needed. Production uses BCFC partner sign-in with staff roles.
dealerSandboxBanner: ⚠️ Sandbox portal: demo stock and leads, no real customer data.
dealerScanNote: ⚠️ In production the portal scans the customer's QR code with the device camera. In the sandbox, type the code shown in their app.
dealerTokenNotFound: Code not recognised. Ask the customer to share again.
dealerTokenExpired: This code has expired. Ask the customer to share again.
dealerSharedOnly: Shared with the customer's consent: first name and limits only. No salary, CPR or obligations.
dealerOverFinance: Financed amount is above the limit
dealerOfferNote: ⚠️ Sandbox: in production the offer goes to the customer's app to accept.
dealerShareButton: Share my pre-approval with a dealer
dealerShareHint: The dealer sees only your first name, car finance limit and max monthly. Never your salary or CPR.
dealerShareCode: Show this code to the dealer
onboardingIntro: Log in with eKey, tell us your salary and see your limits in about 3 minutes.
cprHint: 9 digits, as on your ID card
ekeySandboxNote: Sandbox: no real eKey login. Any 9-digit CPR returns a demo identity.
salaryInvalid: Enter your monthly salary in BHD.
obligationsHint: Loans, cards and other finance. Enter 0 if none.
obligationsInvalid: Enter an amount in BHD (0 or more).
consentIntro: To give you real limits, we need your permission for two checks. You can withdraw it at any time.
consentCrbBody: We check your existing loans and repayments with the Bahrain Credit Reference Bureau.
consentObBody: We read your salary credits from your bank account (read-only). We can't move your money.
consentExpiry: Your consent lasts {days} days, then expires automatically.
consentRequired: Please give both consents to continue.
consentSandboxNote: Sandbox: no CRB or Open Banking data is actually pulled.
noHeadroom: Your current repayments use up your monthly budget, so we can't offer new finance right now.
cardEligibilityDone: Your eligibility check is already done from your pre-approval.
cardApproved: Approved! Your virtual card is ready
walletOnPhone: Adding a card to your wallet happens on your phone. Open the Sahel app and tap Add to Wallet.
cardSandboxNote: Sandbox: no real card is issued. Only the last 4 digits are shown; the full number and CVV are never sent.
cardDeclined: We can't approve this card right now
declineBelowMinSalary: Your salary is below this card's minimum.
declineNoDbrHeadroom: Your current repayments leave no room for a new credit limit.
applyConsent: By applying, you agree to a credit bureau check. Sandbox: no real check is made.
decisionApprovedBody: Good news: your application is approved. Review your offer below.
decisionReferredBody: A credit officer will review your application and update you here.
decisionDeclinedBody: We can't offer this finance right now.
reasonOk: The monthly payment fits within your borrowing room and your pre-approved limit.
reasonDbrExceeded: The monthly payment of {monthly} is more than the {max} you can add under the {cap}% debt-burden limit.
reasonAmountAbovePreapproval: The amount financed, {amount}, is above your pre-approved limit of {limit}.
reasonHighDbrUtilisation: The monthly payment of {monthly} uses most of the {max} you can still add each month, so a person will check it.
tryLowerAmount: Try a bigger down payment, a longer tenure or a lower amount.
statusAssetPurchased: BCFC buys the asset from the seller
statusOwnershipTransferred: BCFC takes ownership of the asset
statusSaleToCustomer: BCFC sells the asset to you at the Murabaha sale price
murabahaSequenceNote: Shari'a requirement: BCFC must own the asset before selling it to you, so these steps always happen in this order.
personalFinanceSubtitle: For anything you need, Islamic or conventional.
lifeEventsIntro: Tell us what's happening and we'll put together what you need, priced for you and checked against your budget.
lifeEntrySubtitle: Getting married, a new job, a first home or a new baby: see a bundle and whether it fits your budget.
lifeRulesNote: Curated by BCFC product rules, not AI.
lifeOtherMonthly: Plus cover premiums, not counted in DBR: {amount}/month
lifeIllustrative: ⚠️ Illustrative bundle: products, prices and premiums are demo values, not an offer. Final terms depend on a full application.
settleFeeNote: ⚠️ Placeholder fee pending CBB rules. Figures are as of your last paid installment.
settleIbraNote: ⚠️ Ibra' is a discretionary rebate on profit not yet earned. Placeholder rule pending BCFC's Shari'a Supervisory Board and CBB rules.
settleAutopayHint: Pay each installment automatically on its due date (sandbox).
insHubSubtitle: Compare insurers side by side. Tasheelat Insurance is a broker, so you see quotes from several insurers.
insMotorBody: Comprehensive or third party, for the car in your garage
insTravelBody: Single trips of up to 180 days, for the whole family
insHomeBody: Building and contents, for one year
insPolicyBindFailed: Payment received, but the policy could not be issued yet. Our team will contact you.
insSandboxNote: ⚠️ Sandbox: demo insurers and illustrative prices.
insErrorDates: Check the dates: the trip must start today or later (within a year) and end on or after the start.
insErrorTripTooLong: A single trip can be at most 180 days.
insErrorTravellers: Check the travellers: 1 to 6 adults and up to 8 children.
insErrorSumInsured: Check the sums insured: building 0 or BHD 10,000 to 2,000,000; contents 0 or BHD 1,000 to 250,000; not both 0.
insErrorNotInsurable: Land can't be insured under home cover.
noCardsYet: No cards yet. Apply in minutes from Cards.
sessionSandboxNote: Sandbox: your profile is kept for this session only, until eKey login is live.
aiGreetingSuhail: Hi! I'm Suhail, your BCFC assistant. Ask me about your installments, early settlement, cars within your budget, insurance or cards, in English or Arabic.
aiGreetingSuhaila: Hi! I'm Suhaila, your BCFC assistant. Ask me about your installments, early settlement, cars within your budget, insurance or cards, in English or Arabic.
aiSuggestBalance: How much do I still owe on the car?
aiSuggestCars: Find me an SUV under BHD 200 a month
aiConfirmNote: Suhail and Suhaila never pay, sign or apply for you: an action opens the usual screen, where you review and confirm.
aiSandboxNote: Sandbox: a rules-based assistant (no AI model yet) that reads only your own session data.
aiErrorRateLimit: Too many messages. Wait a moment and try again.
aiErrorTooLong: That message is too long. Please keep it shorter.
aiErrorGeneric: Sorry, I couldn't answer just now. Please try again.
aiEntryBody: Your balance, next installment or a car within budget, in seconds.
